title: Leave the work where someone can find it
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Name the work — Use the reader’s subject and purpose.; State result and limits — Put the important answer near the entrance.; Show current status — Identify approval, ownership, and review conditions.; Link from the workflow — Make the maintained record easy to reach..
